parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization develops, documents, and disseminates an access control policy that complies with Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat (TBS) Policy on Government Security.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization identifies and selects account types, assigns account managers, and configures account lifecycle controls according to Government of Canada identity assurance levels.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system enforces approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources in accordance with applicable access control policies.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization employs the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses for users and processes necessary to accomplish assigned organizational tasks.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization establishes security awareness and training procedures aligned with CCCS threat intelligence.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization provides basic security awareness training to information system users as part of initial training and annually thereafter.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system identifies and records auditable security events in accordance with CCCS logging guidance.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization reviews and analyzes information system audit records for indications of unusual or suspicious activity.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization assesses the security controls in the information system to determine effectiveness in accordance with ITSG-33 lifecycle Phase 3.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization approves and documents information system interconnections via formal Memorandums of Understanding (MOU).

groups.title: Security Assessment and Authorization (Evaluation et autorisation de securite)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization develops, documents, and maintains a current baseline configuration of the information system.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization develops and documents an inventory of information system components that accurately reflects the current system.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization develops a contingency plan for the information system that addresses system restoration without compromise.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization conducts backups of user-level information, system-level information, and security-related documentation.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system uniquely identifies and authenticates organizational users with mandatory multi-factor authentication (MFA).

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization manages information system authenticators including passwords, tokens, certificates, and biometrics per CSE standards.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization implements an incident handling capability for security incidents that includes coordination with the CCCS Canadian Cyber Incident Response Centre.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization reports information security incidents to designated authorities including the CCCS within mandated reporting windows.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization restricts access to digital and non-digital media containing Protected B or sensitive information.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization sanitizes information system media prior to disposal or reuse in accordance with RCMP and CSE sanitization standards.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization develops and maintains a list of individuals with authorized access to physical facilities housing GC information systems.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization controls all physical access points to facilities processing Government of Canada workloads.

groups.title: Physical and Environmental Protection (Protection physique et environnementale)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization develops, documents, and updates a System Security Plan (SSP) describing security controls and boundary architectures.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization assigns a risk designation to all positions and establishes screening criteria aligned with Government of Canada security clearances.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization screens individuals prior to authorizing access to systems processing sensitive or Protected B data.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization assesses the risk relating to the operation of the information system in accordance with the Harmonized Threat and Risk Assessment (HTRA) methodology.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization scans for vulnerabilities in the information system and hosted applications on a continuous basis.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization includes security requirements, descriptions of functional properties, and supply chain security controls in procurement solicitations.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization mandates that external cloud and service providers comply with CCCS cloud security requirements.

groups.title: System and Services Acquisition (Acquisition de systemes et de services)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system monitors and controls communications at external boundaries and key internal boundaries using approved network security zones.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system protects the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information using CSE Approved Cryptographic Algorithms (CACA / ITSP.40.111).

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system implements cryptographic modules that are FIPS 140-2 or FIPS 140-3 validated in accordance with CSE cryptographic guidance.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system protects the confidentiality and integrity of Protected B information at rest using approved cryptographic algorithms.

groups.title: System and Communications Protection (Protection des systemes et des communications)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization identifies, reports, and corrects information system flaws within mandated remediation timeframes.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system employs anti-malware and threat detection mechanisms at endpoints and network entry points.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system monitors inbound and outbound network traffic to detect attacks and indicators of compromise.

groups.title: System and Information Integrity (Integrite des systemes et de l'information)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization develops and disseminates an organization-wide information security program plan.
